_doc: caves_misc: the low-tide layout. Heights per region (models_cave_levels 'heights'), read from Sapphire's art and from what the high tide floods: 0 = the floor under the top bridge and the corridor under the lower bridge (deep water at high tide), 8 = the shore floor (shallow at high tide), 24 = the raised walkways (dry at high tide), 48 = the plateaus and both bridges (24 above the walkways, so the narrow walkway between them and the shore needs walls on one side only), 64 = the ladder nook north-east (one step up from its plateau). Bridges: Black 2's two-layer walk-under bridges (Seaside Cave chunk 631). The high tide (ShoalCave_HighTideInnerRoom) replaces this zone's matrix while map replace event 9 is set (set in the entrance room); warps 0, 1, 4, 5 are under water then. Origin (9,13): Sapphire (23,19) on the corner of the 2x2 chunks, so each chunk's file stays under Black 2's 110,600-byte chunk buffer (map type 16; at origin (0,0) chunk 0 was 117 KB and the game hung entering the room).
